About Oligo

It began with three childhood friends.

Unlike other children, Gal, Nadav and Avshalom didn’t want to form a rock band or make movies. They dreamed of launching a company that would solve a global problem.

It was whilst building their careers in elite cybersecurity units, they had their lightbulb moment. Gal, Nadav and Avshalom, realised the world desperately needed better application security tools. Equally important, these tools had to work completely differently to those in existence.

The mission was clear. Oligo Security was born.

Life at Oligo

Oligo began as a dream shared by three childhood friends determined to make a real difference on a global scale.

We see our team as the heart of everything we do. We're all about working together, sparking innovation, and doing work that truly matters. We strive to create a supportive environment where everyone can grow personally and professionally, ready to take on new challenges. Join us and bring your creativity to the table!
